question: What claim about the obligation to disclose must hold for the speaker to promise to speak the method of names to the beautiful-eyed one on condition of hearing?
premises: The speaker will speak the method of names of them.
The recipient is addressed as beautiful-eyed.
The recipient is urged to hear.
inference: The speaker promises to disclose the method of their names, urging the beautiful-eyed recipient to listen.
uncertainties: The identity of 'them' is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: I shall speak the method of their names; hear, O beautiful-eyed one.
